tasks-ui.title: The finished page cannot be found or opened from the app (extends the known 'The app never shows where the work is')
tasks-ui.steps: Finish the 5 tasks, then look for the page on Summary, Tasks, Docs and the session log
tasks-ui.actual:

tasks-ui.suggested_fix: Add the workspace path to the project view. Show 'Your files: <path> [Open folder]' on Summary, with a per-task 'Files changed' list; the desktop shell opens the folder or file. Name the folder in the README template.

tasks-ui.title: The move buttons are the raw state machine: unexplained labels, raw state names, and moves that make no sense (Mark failed on a task that never ran)

tasks-ui.actual: A brand-new ready task offers 'Needs me · Mark failed · Cancel · Depends on…'. A running one offers 'Send to review · Needs me · Mark failed · Cancel'; an in_review one 'Mark done · Needs me · Mark failed · Cancel'; done and cancelled rows have none. The dialog's whole explanation is 'ready → needs_human' / 'in_progress → in_review' plus an optional reason. Status badges, the Status filter and the 'Moved…' line use raw states (needs_human, in_progress, in_review, claimed). 'Mark failed' on a never-run task just parks it like Needs me, and its dependants then show the stuck warning. sessions-engine.title: After a daemon crash during a session, the agent can never start a session again in any project; Stop, Stop all and reopening the app do not help
sessions-engine.steps:
1. Start a session on a chain project.
2. While a task is in_progress, end the daemon hard (`restart-daemon.mjs --hard`, the same as a crash, power loss or the Windows process being killed).
3. Reconnect and press Start session on any project.
4. Press Stop on the session page.
5. Press Stop all, then Resume.
6. Quit the daemon cleanly and start it again.
sessions-engine.actual:
- The session page keeps showing "running", "live" and "Current task: Step 4 of 7 ... · coder" with Steps 0/200, although nothing runs.
- The task stays in_progress, "claimed by 01a196e5-a359-739d-a94d-093b99857f03" (a raw id).
- Start is refused with a red banner: "agent Alice already has an active session 01a196ec-e2f7-7292-bb6e-2e2ff2259737".
- Stop on the session page changes nothing.
- Stop all releases the task's claim (Step 4 goes back to ready), but after Resume the session row is still running and Start is still refused.
- After a clean quit and restart, POST /sessions still answers 409 with the same message.
- Home shows no problem ("Waiting on you 0", "Last session just now").
- The person has no way out in the UI. I had to set the row to killed in state.sqlite to carry on.
sessions-engine.expected:
- On start, the daemon closes any work session that no live run belongs to: it marks it interrupted and puts its tasks back to ready.
- Stop on a session that is not running in this process ends the row.
- The refusal names the stuck session and offers to end it.
sessions-engine.root_cause:
- packages/runtime/src/session/runner.ts:507-513 refuses a start while store.session.active() returns a row.
- packages/state/src/repos/session.ts:117 returns every row with status running or paused, whether or not a process is behind it.
- At daemon start only intake sessions are closed: packages/runtime/src/daemon/compose.ts:3386-3391 calls intake.closeExpired() (packages/runtime/src/session/intake.ts:544), which skips any row without plan.intake. Nothing closes work sessions.
- POST /sessions/:id/stop (packages/runtime/src/daemon/server.ts:1241-1245) only calls rt.kill.stop, and KillSwitch.stop (packages/runtime/src/enforcement/killswitch.ts:111-131) only aborts registrations held in this process' memory. It never writes the session row.

links-shell.root_cause: apps/ui/src/pages/project/TasksTab.tsx:332-340 renders a raw <a target="_blank"> instead of the shell-aware pattern in apps/ui/src/components/ExternalLink.tsx:9-29 (no target in the shell, so on_navigation in apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/windows.rs:102 catches it).

Optionally also add .on_new_window in windows.rs that opens http(s) through the opener, so any future target=_blank is safe.
